proves.claim: rebuildOnTrunk returns a commit whose tree equals git merge-tree of trunk and candidate, with both as parents, and leaves refs, index and work tree unchanged.

api.io-gate-rebuild.rebuilt-on-trunk.why: Without this test a gate candidate rebuilt on trunk could carry a wrong tree or move the caller's checkout.

proves.claim: When the merge conflicts rebuildOnTrunk returns the sorted conflicting paths and creates no commit.

api.io-gate-rebuild.conflict-names-files.why: A rebuild that hid its conflicts would hand a gate a candidate that never merged with trunk.
